title: 2026 UK GHG peat fuel methodology QA controls

sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 2026 planned methodology changes
Final UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 1990 to 2024

facts.source_fact: Peat fuel emissions estimates were updated for UK use cases.
The update followed recommendations from a review of the peat model.
A higher calorific value is used for peat.
The higher calorific value replaces the default IPCC value.
facts.expected_handling: Do not mix default and UK-specific values.

facts.source_fact: Fuel peat carbon content from Northern Ireland was increased.
The carbon-content update aligns with UKCEH estimates.
Both calorific value and carbon content affect peat emissions estimates.
The change is exclusive to buildings and product uses.
The revision causes a small increase across the historic time series.
The methodology note is provisional relative to the final statistical release.
facts.expected_handling: Use final release for final values.
